title: Idylls of the Lunar Maria
description:
✨ Idylls of the Lunar Maria is a match-3-inspired roguelite ✨ 

Battle monsters and upgrade your powers with a unique combat system. Meet quirky characters along the way. Whimsical serendipity, mm.

Features:• ⚔️ Fight enemies with a unique match-3-inspired gameplay - Match & merge tiles to attack, heal, defend, cast spells! 

• 👑 Buy charms and upgrades to drastically change the game and defeat any foes you come across 

• ✨ Enjoy a variety of play-styles - Story mode, endless mode, even a rat mode!

🐀 

✨ Tons of characters (240!) to fight against (and with!) ✨

Build up attacks, defensive moves and special powers using the puzzle grid. Line up combos and strategise against your enemies' unique strategies and twists. 

✨ Every run is unique ✨Make game-changing decisions along your journey. The game dynamically varies the types of characters, items and enemies you meet each run.
description_short: Chat with rats and defeat demons in this story-rich roguelite. Discover the puzzling possibilities of Match-3 combat!
